reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing month-fill selection helper, its sign from getAverageBudgetAmount, and writes through setBudget inside batchMessages, registered with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

duplication.why: No duplicated block; the only repetition is the one-line sheet read of 'sum-amount-' that getCategoryAverage also does, plus the usual per-action loop skeleton.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts beside them.

scope.why: Focused, with a small justified rename of getAverageFillCategories to getSpendingFillCategories touching the three average actions.

maintainability.why: Simple and consistent with siblings; reusing getAverageBudgetAmount for a non-average value is slightly misleading by name but keeps the sign rule in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared category selection, sign helper and setBudget.
